content:
The diameter \(AB\) forms a straight angle of \(180^\circ\) in the upper half of the disk. The upper semicircle is split into four sectors with angles

\[
40^\circ + \text{(shaded angle)} + 50^\circ + 30^\circ = 180^\circ.
\]

Thus the shaded sector’s central angle is

\[
180^\circ-(40^\circ+50^\circ+30^\circ)=60^\circ.
\]

Since the point is chosen uniformly from the entire disk, the probability is proportional to the area of the sector:

\[
P=\frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac16.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{1}{6}}
\]
